item.title: Fire Traffic Alert: Misty Moss Dr. – Montgomery – Residential Fire
item.description: 7:05 p.m. Firefighters are battling a housefire on Misty Moss Drive, off of Fountainview Drive off of Walden Road in the Lake Conroe area. Fire has been confirmed in the attic.

item.title: CRASH CLOSES SOUTHBOUND LANES OF I-45 FEEDER
item.description: MAJOR TRAFFIC UPDATE Constable Mark Herman’s Accident Investigation Team continues to investigate the major accident near the 18200 block of the North Freeway. Southbound feeder lanes are shut down while emergency crews work the scene. Two victims have been transported by EMS to a local hospital.
